unlisted_practices: Using AI tools to accelerate trauma clinical guidance development with subject matter expert review of AI initial output
12-step, 24-week clinical guidance development process ending in a bedside clinical decision tree
Multidisciplinary stakeholder involvement in clinical guidance development
Resource-stratified recommendations with offline and multilingual access

screen.reason: The study conducts an empirical acceptability and feasibility survey/focus group evaluation among trauma clinicians and experts regarding a proposed 12-step AI-assisted workflow for clinical guideline development.
